request.input:
3girls, 2boys, exactly five adult companions enjoying dinner together, everyday casual clothing, shared meal, relaxed candid interaction, cozy winter dining room

A single continuous wide narrative illustration, natural anatomy and coherent treatment of all five characters, no panels or dividers.

Preserve the base image's composition and identities. From left to right: silver ponytail woman seated smiling and pointing to her own cheek; silver-haired elf man standing pouring tea; brown-haired woman seated eating cake with a small white cream smear and two golden cake crumbs near her mouth; exceptionally tall muscular dark-skinned man standing serving stew, a full head taller than the elf even while leaning forward; blonde woman seated with her bowl. Three seated women and two standing men, one wooden table, one table-supported stew pot, cups and bowls on the table, cake on a plate and bread inside a basket, no food on bare wood. Natural shoulders, necks, arms and utensil grips; modest uncluttered tabletop.

Warm amber hanging lamp and hearth illuminate faces, hands and ceramics; blue snowy night through the rear window, believable shared light direction, warm and cool shadow planes, gentle steam, comfortable cotton and knitted everyday clothing.
